description: A family of nonempty subsets of a common carrier indexed by a countable set has a choice function selecting a member of each subset.
signature:
Classical.axiomOfChoice.{u, v} {α : Sort u} {β : α → Sort v} {r : (x : α) → β x → Prop} (h : ∀ (x : α), ∃ y, r x y) :
  ∃ f, ∀ (x : α), r x (f x)
